# MCP tools: AI steps

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 8 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `set_ai_plan`

Write a plan for a task the owner wants to hand to AI: the steps in order, each for the owner (performer owner) or for AI (performer ai, with an ai_spec).

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `AiPlanOutput` with `plan` (AiPlanRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `steps` | array of object | yes | 1 to 12 items |
| `steps[].performer` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `ai` |
| `steps[].ai_spec` | object | no | may be null |
| `steps[].ai_spec.goal` | string | yes | 1 to 500 characters |
| `steps[].ai_spec.budget` | object | no | - |
| `steps[].ai_spec.budget.max_turns` | integer | no | default `8`; 1 to 12 |
| `steps[].ai_spec.budget.max_usd` | number | no | default `1.0`; above 0; up to 1000.0 |
| `steps[].ai_spec.capabilities` | array of string | no | up to 4 items; items: `web_search`, `web_fetch`, `read_task_context`, `code` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.context` | object | no | Which linked records the brief may name; titles and names only, never contact details. |
| `steps[].ai_spec.context.include_contacts` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.context.include_references` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.done_when` | array of string | no | up to 5 items |
| `steps[].ai_spec.effects` | string | no | default `"none"`; one of `none`, `draft`; What a step may do outside its own result. |
| `steps[].ai_spec.output` | object | no | - |
| `steps[].ai_spec.output.format` | string | no | default `"text"`; one of `text`, `markdown`, `checklist`, `table`, `email_draft` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.output.max_chars` | integer | no | default `8000`; 1 to 32000 |
| `steps[].ai_spec.privacy` | string | no | default `"normal"`; one of `normal`, `local_only` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.runner` | string | no | default `"any"`; one of `any`, `claude_code`, `server` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.spec_version` | 1 | no | default `1` |
| `steps[].ai_spec.stop_and_ask` | array of string | no | up to 5 items |
| `steps[].instruction` | string | no | up to 2000 characters; may be null |
| `steps[].step_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `steps[].title` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `task_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `get_ai_plan`

Read a task's plan: its steps with who performs them, the digest the owner approves, the plan's state (none, draft, approved, changed_since_approval) and each AI step's status and latest run.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`.

Returns: `AiPlanOutput` with `plan` (AiPlanRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |

## `cancel_ai_step_run`

Stop a queued or running AI step run.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:write`.

Returns: `AiRunOutput` with `run` (AiRunRecord), `content` (AiRunContentRecord or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `run_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `run_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

## `list_ai_steps`

List AI steps of approved plans, by task and position, with where each stands (waiting, ready, running, to_review, needs_input, failed, stopped, exhausted, done) and whether it is startable now. state=ready lists what can be started.

Access: read

Scopes: requires at least one of `ai:run`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `AiStepPageOutput` with `items` (array of AiStepEntryRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 50 |
| `state` | string | no | one of `ready`, `running`, `to_review`, `needs_input`, `failed`; may be null |
| `task_id` | uuid | no | may be null |

## `start_ai_step`

Start one ready AI step of an approved plan.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `ai:run`, `tasks:read`; some arguments or parts of the answer also use `contacts:read`, `projects:read`.

Returns: `StartedAiStepOutput` with `brief` (string), `budget_usd` (number), `max_turns` (integer), `run` (AiRunRecord), `step_id` (uuid).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `step_id` | uuid | yes | - |

## `report_ai_step_result`

Report how a started run ended: outcome result (with the result), question (the owner must answer) or failed.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `ai:run`.

Returns: `AiRunOutput` with `run` (AiRunRecord), `content` (AiRunContentRecord or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `outcome` | string | yes | one of `result`, `question`, `failed` |
| `run_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `run_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `failure_category` | string | no | one of `blocked`, `unclear_goal`, `tool_error`, `budget`, `other`, `provider`, `refused`, `invalid_output`; may be null |
| `question` | string | no | up to 1000 characters; may be null |
| `result` | object | no | may be null |
| `result.format` | string | yes | one of `text`, `markdown`, `checklist`, `table`, `email_draft` |
| `result.summary` | string | yes | 1 to 500 characters |
| `result.text` | string | yes | 1 to 32000 characters |
| `result.checklist` | array of object | no | up to 100 items |
| `result.checklist[].action_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `result.checklist[].done` | boolean | yes | - |
| `usage` | object | no | may be null |
| `usage.cache_read_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |
| `usage.cache_write_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |
| `usage.cost_usd_estimate` | number | no | default `0.0`; 0 to 1000 |
| `usage.input_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |
| `usage.model` | string | no | up to 120 characters; may be null |
| `usage.output_tokens` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 1000000000000 |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

## `review_ai_step_result`

The owner's decision on a run: accept (completes the step and ticks the actions the result reported as done), redo (another attempt, with a comment), reject (stops AI on the step) or answer (replies to the run's question).

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:write`.

Returns: `AiRunOutput` with `run` (AiRunRecord), `content` (AiRunContentRecord or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `decision` | string | yes | one of `accept`, `redo`, `reject`, `answer` |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `run_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `run_version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `comment` | string | no | up to 1000 characters; may be null |

## `get_ai_step_run`

Read one run: its state, cost and attempt.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`.

Returns: `AiRunOutput` with `run` (AiRunRecord), `content` (AiRunContentRecord or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `run_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `include_content` | boolean | no | default `false` |
